summary.text: Yama Child is Fang Yuan's killer move. It produces human-shaped ghostly monsters remade from soul beasts.

claims.text: Meng Tu sees each ghostly monster has rank seven battle strength. Fang Yuan is pleased with that showing. The killer move Yama child was deduced from consulting blood deity and main contents of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s true inheritance, including soul beast modification. Spectral Soul modified soul beasts in the Door of Life and Death so they stayed loyal and faced Duke Long without fearing death.

The monsters howl, spread huge arms, and crush Meng Tu’s blade path phantoms. Fang Yuan had gathered the ancient soul beasts in green ghost desert. Quantity is limited because he had limited time to modify enough of them. Injured ones can be recalled. When they return to the emperor robe they recover by spending his soul foundation. The yama child is still a soul beast, and that healing is like a Gu refinement process. One yama child spent on soul explosion makes a peak rank seven blast that still does not reach rank eight. Fang Yuan rates the yama child aspect at the peak of rank seven.

Fang Yuan shouts Immortal killer move Yama Child together with emperor yama and soul explosion. In emperor yama form he sends the yama child army at Feng Jiu Ge from all directions, with soul explosions mixed in, until blood flows from Feng Jiu Ge’s mouth. Fang Yuan’s enslavement path attainment is not high, but he can still order them fluidly. They attack without fearing death and are tougher to deal with than ancient desolate beasts. Green jade song warrior often shatters them into jade statues. Submission song, a method against enslavement path, only affects their movement and has no enslavement effect on them. Fang Yuan holds that yama child uses soul beast modification, soul beast summoning, and other methods within Spectral Soul true inheritance, with ghostly concealment at the core, which is why submission song cannot enslave them. Yama children then rush up and sacrifice themselves to protect great thief ghost hand as it carries Fixed Immortal Travel into Fang Yuan’s immortal aperture.
